title: Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder 15-Inch Solid Brass Cabinet Mount | Prestige Regal Collection Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your kitchen organization with a space-saving under cabinet paper towel holder crafted from solid brass. Designed for cabinet-mount installation, it keeps rolls within easy reach while helping keep counters clutter-free. Part of the prestige regal collection for a coordinated, traditional look.

Highlights:
- Solid brass construction for enduring performance
- Under-cabinet, cabinet-mount design saves counter space
- Left- or right-hand opening for flexible placement
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs:
- Collection: Prestige Regal (traditional/classic styling)
- Overall size: 15-Inch L x 7-Inch H x 2.5-Inch W
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Cabinet mount
- Assembly: No assembly required
- Included: Paper towel holder and installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Product weight: 3.2 lb
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Design notes: Ideal for those seeking matching prestige regal pieces and classic bath accessories styling carried into the kitchen.

_previous.title: Prestige Regal Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder
_previous.description: Attractive design brings together a touch of style and efficiency to your kitchen. This solid brass paper towel holder can be mounted under the cabinet with a left or right hand opening and will accommodate the extra depth of today's super-sized paper towel rolls. This simple counter-saving design fits any décor, is easy to load, keeps counters clutter-free, and is available in 14 contemporary and traditional finishes.
